Speak, link, remember.

Open-source system-wide dictation that builds a vault of linked notes.

Download for macOS More platforms

Your voice stays local. SpeechFlow runs inference entirely on your device. No cloud calls, no accounts, no data leaves your machine.

Your notes are yours. Markdown files with wikilinks, stored on disk. No proprietary format, no lock-in. Export everything, always.

Your tools are auditable. Fully open source. Every connector, adapter, and vault operation ships in the repo. Inspect, fork, extend.

Free and open source. Download now

Capture and connect.

From lecture halls to late-night study sessions, SpeechFlow turns spoken ideas into structured knowledge.

Dictation

System-wide voice input in any application. Local ASR transcribes, you preview before inserting. Speak anywhere you can type.

Linked notes

Atomic notes connected by [[wikilinks]]. Assignments, readings, and ideas form a navigable graph—not a single long document.

Course connectors

Pull assignments, announcements, and readings from Canvas into your vault. Structured metadata, not bulk content.

Local inference

Swap model backends freely—GGUF, Core ML, local servers. The InferenceBackend protocol is the only contract.
